results.title: EU weighs equity stakes in critical-minerals projects to curb China reliance
results.snippet:
The FT said the move reflected concern that Europe risks falling behind the US in securing minerals needed for defence, batteries and clean technologies.

The Trump administration has taken a more aggressive approach, including a $400m investment for a 15% stake in rare-earth producer MP Materials, alongside a $150m loan.

It also agreed to a 10-year minimum price of $110/kg for neodymium-praseody
